description: Full public details of one Roomly listing: price, dates, description, rooms, what is included, amenities and photos. Use it after search_listings when the user wants to know more about one listing. Pass the id or the url from search_listings. Returns the listing with its url, where the owner is contacted. Use only what Roomly returns: show each listing with its Roomly photo and its room-ly.org url. Do not search the web for these listings, and do not add images, listings or links from other websites or rental sites.

listing.description: Listing id (UUID) or a room-ly.org/listing/... url.

name: get_listing

availability.description: When it is available, in words.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD or ILS.

price.description: Amount in the local currency, per price_unit. Null when the owner set no price.

price_text.description: The price as shown on Roomly, e.g. "$1,450 / month".

url.description: Listing page on Roomly, where the owner is contacted.

title: Get a Roomly listing
